chapter: Charlie Johnson, Willie Gant and the late 1920s
title: Willie Gant's band and the aftermath of Johnson's return
summary: Gant's 1926 band was very good, but the group dissolved when Charlie Johnson returned.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: But I mean Willie Gant was in that class.
He was in that class, right in that class.
Now, when you mention Tatum, of course, this was later, wasn't it, when Tatum came, wasn't it?
Yeah. Yeah, that's interesting, but it's very strange how Willie Gant, everybody sort of knew about the man name, but he never made records.
No, he should've made a (unintelligible) record went down in 1926, very good band, had a very good band down there. Really did. Fine guy to get along with too.
Well, what happened then when Charlie Johnson came back from Atlantic City?

When Charlie came back, well, band like tunin- dissolved fellows, different members (unintelligible) because everybody, (unintelligible) out of the band. They just -- taking these guys here, there and everywhere, you know, and that's what happened. Then Willie got small jobs, was doing all right for himself, so he stayed that way.
